profile.description: Complete llm-provider default profile unit (PLAN-0504); an empty value clears the layer to inherit.

imageProfile.description: Global default image generation model (PLAN-0523 decision #5/#7): connection-scoped identity, instance-layer only; an empty value clears.

modelParams.description: Per-model sampling parameters (PLAN-0523 decision #9/#12): map of model name to optional {maxTokens, temperature, timeout}. PUT replaces the whole map; an empty object clears. Layer-scoped (whole-domain override).
